clips.title: The story
paras: Felix Whindlebolt's box lies in Frostmane camps southwest of Anvilmar, far from the gnome refugee who lost it.

Radiation swept through Gnomeregan during the failed attempt to purge the trogg menace, and Felix Whindlebolt fled with the gnomes into Coldridge Valley. In his rush to escape the fumes, he left his personal possessions and crafting gear along the snowy road. Frostmane trolls plundered the roadside goods before Felix could return. They carried his box, his chest, and his bucket of bolts to their settlements southwest of Anvilmar.

Felix is unused to violence and poorly suited to Dun Morogh's wilderness, so he needs passing adventurers in Anvilmar to help recover his belongings. Getting them back would restore a measure of normalcy and the means to earn a living for the displaced artisan, who lost everything when Gnomeregan fell.
